== Decipher checklist and printed faces ==
The [{{fullurl:Reflections III|oldid=352369}} set checklist] has 100 premium cards and 100 diffraction foils. The two Objective cards add one reverse face each in the table. Decipher’s [https://web.archive.org/web/20030403064537id_/http://www2.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/r3cardlist.pdf collector’s card list] attributes six diffraction foils to [[Theed Palace]]. The two Episode I tournament foils appear on the print sheets and are outside the list of 100 diffraction foils.

Decipher’s fold-out checklist calls [[Qui-Gon's End]] a Lost Interrupt and [[Where Are Those Droidekas?!]] a Defensive Shield. The printed faces show an Immediate Effect and an Effect, respectively. [[:File:Ref3-D-quigonsend-decipher-archive.jpg|Qui-Gon’s End face]] · [[:File:Ref3-D-wherearethosedroidekas-decipher-archive.jpg|Where Are Those Droidekas?! face]].
